title: Run the assurance checks inside the live pipeline and re-measure through the platform
scope: Make the platform, not a standalone script, responsible for the TAX-118 results: when a refund claim reaches a case, the pipeline runs the TAX-112-116 checks through the TAX-111 source adapters, stores each result as a TAX-086 case finding with its legal route, proposes the TAX-114 lane, and a live benchmark run reads findings and lanes back from the platform and scores them against the sealed TAX-118 answer key

acceptance.text: An outbox step after case registration runs the assurance checks for the case's taxpayer and claim, idempotently, and records every finding (category, explanation, evidence refs, unresolved amount, candidate legal route or policy gap) as a TAX-086 finding with producer and version; the proposed lane, service target and undisputed amount are readable per claim; nothing decides, pays, denies or assesses

A live benchmark mode seeds the 200 TAX-118 test taxpayers (or a stated subset when resources limit it) into Frappe, lets the pipeline run, reads findings and lanes back through the platform and scores them with the TAX-118 scorer; results are committed beside the standalone run with every difference explained
Degraded services (Jube, Docling, OpenAleph or yente unavailable) are reported per case and in the results as not run, never as clean; the run states which services were live and which were recorded
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Live benchmark mode results committed beside the standalone TAX-118 run with every difference explained

evidence.text: A sent refund claim enqueues assurance.requested as the case's first outbox event. This is a new contract EventEnvelope.type. The hook is assurance.store.on_submission_sent, which runs before the TAX-039 bridge and shares its correlation ID, so the step does not depend on Jube. handle_assurance_requested reads the site's recorded RSL fixture (vati_rsl_sources) and the taxpayer's records document, then runs assess_taxpayer unchanged. It records each finding as a TAX-086 Vati Case Finding with producer vati_check (new enum value in the contract, rules and DocType) and version tax118-pipeline-v1. Each finding carries a category, the explanation from the check's reason, evidence_refs and source_refs, the unresolved amount, the alternatives tested, and a candidate_route. The legal route stays unverified, or no_verified_route for a policy gap. The proposed action needs human approval. Each claim gets an append-only Vati Lane Proposal (lane, reasons, service target and due date, claimed, undisputed and disputed amounts, inputs, line matches). Each event gets one Vati Assurance Run. No decision field is ever set (ADR-042). Observed: assurance/test_rules.py 19 tests OK. tests/ai/test_assurance_live.py 7 tests OK; replay writes nothing twice. assurance/test_assurance_bench.py 6 tests OK on a disposable site; a resend replays findings and lanes.

Command: python3 -m ai.evaluation.assurance_live run. It used _load_sealed() (hashes match) and the rule fingerprint equal to the TAX-118 freeze. It seeded all 200 test taxpayers and 4185 refund claims into the disposable site tax121-live-20261106t132901.localhost (dropped afterwards). The outbox drained in 475.5 s with all 4185 assurance steps delivered. An auditor read every case back through assurance.store.case_assurance, and the results were scored with assurance_benchmark.score. Live equals the standalone run of the same taxpayers and the committed TAX-118 results on every metric: issue flagged 86.5% (32/37), clean flagged 8.0% (13/163), lane accuracy 94.0% (3935/4185), valid claims fast 62.6% (2590/4135), fakes not fast 96.0% (48/50), routes 100% (41/41). There were 0 per-taxpayer or per-claim differences. Only time differs: 0.9484 s against 0.0134 s per taxpayer, because each claim case re-runs the taxpayer assessment and records in Frappe. Explained in docs/evidence/TAX-121/RESULTS.md and results.json.

Each Vati Assurance Run records services and per-check status. A missing fixture config, or e-Tax or the Online Refunds Application unavailable, gives not_run with a reason code (upstream_unavailable, etax_unavailable) and records no findings or lanes. An unavailable optional system gives degraded_<system>_unavailable. This is covered by the bench and host tests. In the live run, Frappe was live in 4185 cases. RSL sources were recorded (TAX-111 fixture, all systems ok) and the taxpayer records were live. Jube, Docling, OpenAleph and yente were not configured. The Jube case.registered step ended as dead_letter 1200, retry 2815 and pending 170 (jube_not_configured), reported as unavailable, never clean. scripts/frappe_dev.py verify: first run 195 bench tests, FAILED (failures=2, errors=1); a second verify run was OK (195). Rerunning on the kept site gave 3 failures, all in reminders.test_reminders_bench, which is pre-existing and flaky and not touched here. All assurance, bridge, pipeline, findings and outbox bench tests passed. python3 scripts/dev.py check, scripts/quality.py and scripts/validate.py passed.

PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/280. dev.py check and validate.py passed (rerun by the parent); quality.py passed; live benchmark 0 differences vs TAX-118 on 200 taxpayers / 4,185 claims.

notes.text: Added 2026-11-06 at Keletso's request so the system itself is responsible for the measured results (TAX-118 ran the checks directly, outside the services).
